description: This Java class 'ReportMailingJobValidator' provides validation logic for creating and updating report mailing jobs, including email validation, date parsing, and JSON parameter checks within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobValidator
classes.description: Validator class for report mailing job creation and update requests, including email validation and JSON parameter checks.

methods.name: validateCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for creating a new report mailing job, checking required fields, date formats, and email addresses.

methods.name: validateUpdateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for updating an existing report mailing job, with similar checks as create but optional fields.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if a given email string matches the email regex pattern.

methods.name: validateEmailRecipients
methods.description: Splits and validates multiple email addresses from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: validateStretchyReportParamMap
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON string into a HashMap for stretchy report parameters.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if there are any validation errors collected.
